_howto: THE LINE — merch showcase data. merch.js renders these cards in array
order into the #merch-grid on the home page; every card links to the
store. To add a drop: put its 800px-wide webp art in src/merch/,
add an entry here ({id, garment, title, description, image}), and add
the image path to the build's file list is NOT needed (the whole merch/
folder ships). 'description' doubles as the storefront listing copy.

items.title: Vol. 1 — For The Culture (Murder Mitten)
items.description: The one that started it — the full murder mitten scene across the back: both peninsulas, the Mackinac Bridge, and a Freewill Ridez pack in 485C red running formation while the lead bike wheelies right past the cruiser. Three-ink print with dripping FREEWILLRIDEZ lettering up top and For The Culture in script below, because that's exactly what this drop is.

items.title: Vol. 2 — Till Death Do Us Part
items.description: Vol. 2 puts the vow in ink: two riders tucked and rolling under the I-96 West sign while the reaper stands scythe-up behind them and the helicopter spotlight sweeps the bridge. Cream, dark red, and teal on black — TILL DEATH DO US PART across the bottom, and we mean it.

items.title: Vol. 3 — Detroit Motor City
items.description: A rider carves past the Detroit skyline in cream, FL orange, and 287C blue, printed heavy across the back. Motor City made this crew — Vol. 3 puts the proof on your back.

items.title: Vol. 4 — Living Ghost
items.description: A pack of riders rolls out of a purple haze behind you, gold bike out front, ghost-eyed visors trailing — white, purple, and gold ink on black. Vol. 4 is for the ones who move through the city like they were never there.

items.title: Vol. 5 — King of the Streets
items.description: Two up, throttle pinned, smoke rolling off the rear tire — gold and burgundy ink under the arched FREEWILLRIDEZ banner. A hoodie that earns its crown the way the crew does: on the pavement, not in the comments.

items.title: Truly Wanted
items.description: Two riders parked in front of Michigan Central Station, Detroit glowing red behind them, with a Ghostface heart and blood-red script that says exactly what it means. Cream, red, and brown ink on a black tee — Freewill Ridez, wanted in the only way that counts.

items.title: Public Enemy Number One
items.description: Athletic gold and two-tone grey on black — the Michigan crest, one bike, and a wall of badges closing in. A shirt for the ones who got labeled the problem and kept riding anyway.

items.title: Michigan Central Box Logo
items.description: Red Freewillridez box logo up front, the whole crew lined up at Michigan Central Station across the back. Red, white, and grey ink on a heavyweight hoodie — home turf, worn loud.
